1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, __wherein said first and second components are modular and interchangeable__.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature __that are non-uniform and asymmetric__.

4. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is elliptically shaped __with asymmetric curvature in at least one plane__.

10. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface component.

12. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface component for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface __with a specific surface finish of Ra less than 0.8 micrometers__.

14. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Original) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Original) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Original) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem is __selectable from a plurality of stems of different lengths, wherein each selected stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus__.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw __with a locking mechanism__.

23. (Cancelled)

24. (Cancelled)

25. (Cancelled)

26. (Cancelled)

27. (Currently Amended) __An implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint, comprising a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and an implant component__.

28. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 27 wherein said implant component is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) __A humeral implant adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone, comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem__.

30. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear __and non-adjustable in length__.

32. (Cancelled)
